findings.message: Start event "start" is one of 2 blank start events in process "events"; Camunda allows one.
findings.suggestion: Keep one blank start event and give the others an event definition.

findings.message: Start event "start2" is one of 2 blank start events in process "events"; Camunda allows one.
findings.suggestion: Keep one blank start event and give the others an event definition.

findings.message: Timer start event "startTimerDuration" uses timeDuration, which Camunda does not allow on this event.
findings.suggestion: Use another kind of timer.

findings.message: Timer intermediate catch event "catchNoTimer" has no timer value; set one of timeDate, timeDuration.
findings.suggestion: Set when the timer fires.

findings.message: Timer intermediate catch event "catchBadDuration" has timeDuration "5 minutes", which is not an ISO 8601 duration (PT15M).
findings.suggestion: Write an ISO 8601 duration (PT15M), or a FEEL expression starting with "=".

findings.message: Timer intermediate catch event "catchCycle" uses timeCycle, which Camunda does not allow on this event.
findings.suggestion: Use another kind of timer.

findings.message: Message intermediate catch event "catchMsgNoRef" references no message.
findings.suggestion: Reference a bpmn:message with a name.

findings.message: Message intermediate catch event "catchMsgNoName" references message "Msg_noname", which has no name.
findings.suggestion: Name the message — Camunda correlates on it.

findings.message: Message "Msg_noname" used by Message intermediate catch event "catchMsgNoName" has no zeebe:subscription.
findings.suggestion: Add a zeebe:subscription with a correlationKey to the message.

findings.message: Message "nokey" used by Message intermediate catch event "catchMsgNoKey" has no zeebe:subscription.
findings.suggestion: Add a zeebe:subscription with a correlationKey to the message.

findings.message: Signal intermediate catch event "catchSignalNoName" references signal "Sig_noname", which has no name.
findings.suggestion: Name the signal — Camunda broadcasts on it.

findings.message: Conditional intermediate catch event "catchConditional" needs Camunda 8.9 or newer; this model targets Camunda 8.8.
findings.suggestion: Target Camunda 8.9 or newer (modeler:executionPlatformVersion), or remove it.

findings.message: Timer boundary event "boundaryCycle" uses timeCycle, which Camunda does not allow on this event.
findings.suggestion: Use another kind of timer.

findings.message: Escalation boundary event "boundaryEscalation" is attached to Service task "Work"; a task cannot throw an escalation, so Camunda does not allow it there.
findings.suggestion: Attach it to a sub-process or call activity instead.

findings.message: Escalation intermediate throw event "throwEscalationNoRef" references no escalation.
findings.suggestion: Reference a bpmn:escalation with an escalation code.

findings.message: Escalation intermediate throw event "throwEscalationNoCode" references escalation "no code", which has no escalation code.
findings.suggestion: Set the escalation code.

findings.message: Message intermediate throw event "throwMessage" has no implementation; Camunda needs a zeebe:taskDefinition.
findings.suggestion: Set a job type (zeebe:taskDefinition).

findings.message: Compensate intermediate throw event "throwCompensation" sets waitForCompletion="false"; Camunda always waits for compensation to complete.
findings.suggestion: Remove waitForCompletion, or set it to "true".

findings.message: Error end event "endErrorNoRef" references no error.
findings.suggestion: Reference a bpmn:error with an error code.

findings.message: Error end event "endErrorNoCode" references error "no code", which has no error code.
findings.suggestion: Set the error code.

findings.message: Signal end event "endSignalNoRef" references no signal.
findings.suggestion: Reference a bpmn:signal with a name.

findings.message: Timer start event "subTimerCycle" uses timeCycle, which Camunda does not allow on this event.
findings.suggestion: Use another kind of timer.

findings.message: Message "nokey" used by Message start event "subMessage" has no zeebe:subscription.
findings.suggestion: Add a zeebe:subscription with a correlationKey to the message.
